title: Migration 52 — pre-migration defect characterisation
description: The counterfactual for migration 52. Applies migrations 24 and 28 and deliberately NOT 52, then writes a two-report COA pack through migration 28's own record_document_field_extraction and asserts that the two reports are indistinguishable afterwards: no grouping column exists, and extracted_at ties because now() is the transaction timestamp, so 'the most recent row by extracted_at' identifies no row. This proves migration 52 closes a real defect rather than a hypothesised one. It fails if the defect is absent, which would mean 52's premise is wrong.

verify.note: Section A reproduces the pre-52 merge on a real cluster. It raises if migration 52 turns out to be applied, so the fixture cannot pass by accidentally testing the fixed schema.
